```yaml
name: AI Docs Review Command
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr:
        description: 'Pull Request number'
        required: true
        type: number
      repo:
        description: 'Repository name (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
        type: string
      gitref:
        description: 'Git reference (unused, kept for dispatcher compatibility)'
        required: false
        type: string
      comment-id:
        description: 'Comment ID for slash command (optional)'
        required: false
        type: string

# Security model:
# This workflow runs on a user-provided PR number and checks out that PR's head ref.
# For fork PRs, we check out refs/pull/<PR>/head from the base repository (github.repository),
# which is safe because:
# 1. The PR head ref is already validated by GitHub as part of the PR creation process
# 2. We don't have write access to the fork repository, so no malicious code can be injected there
# 3. The checkout happens in a clean environment with no prior state
# 4. The workflow only reads files and doesn't modify anything
# 5. The workflow uses the base repository context for API calls, ensuring proper permissions

jobs:
  ai-docs-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Validate inputs
        id: validate
        run: |
          if [ -z "${{ inputs.pr }}" ]; then
            echo "error=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "message=Missing required 'pr' input" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "error=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Post error comment if validation fails
        if: steps.validate.outputs.error == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            Failed to trigger AI docs review: ${{ steps.validate.outputs.message }}
            
            Please ensure you've provided a valid PR number when invoking this workflow.

      - name: Checkout PR head
        if: steps.validate.outputs.error != 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: refs/pull/${{ inputs.pr }}/head
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Get changed files
        if: steps.validate.outputs.error != 'true'
        id: get_files
        run: |
          # Use --paginate to handle PRs with more than 30 changed files
          files=$(gh api --paginate -X GET "repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/${{ inputs.pr }}/files" --jq '.[].filename')
          echo "files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "$files" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "file_count=$(echo "$files" | wc -l)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Post start comment
        if: steps.validate.outputs.error != 'true' && steps.get_files.outputs.file_count > 0
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            Starting AI documentation review for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}...
            
            This may take a few minutes. Please do not comment on this PR while the review is running.

      - name: Post skip comment
        if: steps.validate.outputs.error != 'true' && steps.get_files.outputs.file_count == 0
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v1.4.5
        with:
          token: ${{ github.token }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          body: |
            Skipping AI documentation review for PR #${{ inputs.pr }} as there are no changed files.

      - name: Run AI docs review
        if: steps.validate.outputs.error != 'true' && steps.get_files.outputs.file_count > 0
        uses: aaronsteers/devin-action@0d74d6d9ff1b16ada5966dc31af53a9d155759f4
        with:
          comment-id: ${{ inputs.comment-id }}
          issue-number: ${{ inputs.pr }}
          playbook-macro: "!connectordocs-pr-review"
          devin-token: ${{ secrets.DEVIN_TOKEN }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          start-message: "Starting AI documentation review for PR #${{ inputs.pr }}"
          tags: "docs,review"
          dry-run: false
```
